KY.note: No statewide parcel service. kygisserver.ky.gov hosts only Webster County PVA parcels; other parcels are per-county PVA sites or paid aggregators.

LA.note: No statewide parcel service. Parcels are held by parish assessors (e.g. Orleans, East Baton Rouge); statewide sets are paid only.

ME.name: Maine GeoLibrary, Maine Parcels Organized Towns
ME.coverage: partial: organized towns that volunteered data; no Unorganized Territories
ME.note: Boundary and Parcel_ID only. Shape__Area is square meters (UTM 19N); compute acres from geometry. Owner data is in a separate table, not on this layer. Many towns stale.

MD.name: Maryland Dept. of Planning / SDAT, MD iMAP Parcel Boundaries
MD.note: No owner-name field (only owner mailing address). JURSCODE is a 4-letter county code. Use mdgeodata.md.gov host; geodata.md.gov returned a 503 maintenance page. SDATWEBADR links to the SDAT record.

MA.name: MassGIS, Massachusetts Property Tax Parcels (Level 3)
MA.note: New URL since 2026-04; old L3_TAXPAR_POLY_ASSESS_gdb returns 400. LOT_SIZE units vary (LOT_UNITS) and the sample value looked wrong; safer to compute acres from geometry. No county field; CITY is the town. MAP_PAR_ID is the local map-parcel id.

MI.note: No statewide parcel service. Michigan parcels are per-county; state DNR layer covers only state-owned land.

MN.name: MnGeo, Minnesota Parcels (Open)
MN.note: Only counties that allow open sharing. Address is split: anumber + st_pre_dir + st_name + st_pos_typ, city in ctu_name. acres_deed also available. county_pin is the local id.

MS.name: Mississippi DEQ, Parcels Statewide 2023
MS.note: Newer 2024 data at gis.mississippi.edu/server/rest/services/Cadastral/MS_Parcels_August_2024/MapServer layers 1 (West) and 2 (East), same fields, CORS ok, but split in two. TAXACRES also available.

MO.note: No statewide parcel service. MSDIS/gis.mo.gov has only state-owned parcels; county parcels are per-assessor or paid aggregators.

MT.name: Montana State Library, MSDI Cadastral - Montana Parcels
MT.note: Old gisservicemt.gov MSDI_Framework/Parcels URL now returns an HTML page. GISAcres also available; CityStateZip completes the address.

NE.name: State of Nebraska, Statewide Parcels Current
NE.note: No owner field in the public layer. County_ID is a code, not a name. Acres_Deeded also available; Parcel_URL links to the county record.

NV.name: Nevada DOT (data from NV Division of State Lands), Statewide Parcels 2018
NV.note: Left out: a 2018 snapshot, and Nevada state parcel services say county parcel data may not be redistributed (NRS 250). Use the county assessor. The service tested was https://gis.dot.nv.gov/agsphs/rest/services/Reference/Statewide_Parcels/MapServer/0

NH.name: NH Dept. of Revenue Administration / GRANIT, Parcel Mosaic
NH.note: No owner field (the 'Name' field is a parcel label, not owner). Shape_Area is sq ft (NH State Plane ft); divide by 43560. Town gives the town; CountyId is a number. PID is the local map-lot.

NJ.name: NJ Office of GIS, Parcels and MOD-IV Composite
NJ.note: OWNER_NAME field exists but is blank (redacted under Daniel's Law). PROP_LOC is street only; MUN_NAME gives the town.

NM.note: No statewide parcel service. Each of 33 county assessors holds parcels; state (TRD/RGIS) publishes only tax districts and BLM surface-ownership layers.

NY.name: NYS GIS Program Office, NYS Tax Parcels Public
NY.note: Only counties that permit public sharing; layer 0 is the footprint of covered counties. Old gisservices.its.ny.gov URL now returns HTML. ACRES (assessor) also available.

NC.name: NC OneMap / NC CGIA, Statewide Parcels
NC.note: No login needed despite '/secure/' in the path. ownname2 holds second owner; scity is site city.
